_texte.Ce se întâmplă dacă echipamentul este de: What happens if the equipment is damaged?
_texte.Clientul rezervă — tu confirmi disponibi: The customer books — you confirm availability
_texte.Completezi formularul de partener → aleg: You fill in the partner form → choose the “Rental operator" role. You upload the documents: tax ID, ISCIR (if applicable), motor insurance for transport vehicles.
_texte.Cum funcționează — flux operator închiri: How it works — rental operator flow
_texte.Curierul de Cartier sau partenerul de tr: The Neighbourhood Courier or the transport partner handles the logistics.
_texte.Da, poți declina o rezervare în termen d: Yes, you can decline a booking within 2 hours of receiving it. Repeated refusals without a valid reason affect your visibility score in the marketplace.
_texte.Da. Tu definești perioada minimă în prof: Yes. You define the minimum period in the equipment profile — 1 day, 3 days, 1 week, etc. My Darrin doesn't impose a standard.
_texte.De ce să închiriezi prin My Darrin?: Why rent out through My Darrin?
_texte.Devino operator de închirieri pe My Darr: Become a rental operator on My Darrin — offer machinery and equipment, managed through the platform.
_texte.Devino Operator de Închirieri · My Darri: Become a Rental Operator · My Darrin
_texte.Din portal adaugi fiecare echipament: de: In the portal you add each piece of equipment: name, category, photos, technical specifications, price per day/week/month, security deposit and your rental conditions.
_texte.Fiecare echipament este asigurat automat: Every piece of equipment is insured automatically during transport.
_texte.Fotografii la ridicare și la returnare —: Photos at collection and return — full protection against damage.
_texte.Gata să îți pui flota la muncă?: Ready to put your fleet to work?
_texte.La primirea rezervării, confirmi din apl: When you receive the booking, you confirm in the app that the equipment is available and in working order. You have 2 hours to confirm.
_texte.La returnare documentezi daunele cu foto: On return, you record any damage with photos. The repair cost is deducted from the customer's security deposit or, if it exceeds the deposit, a claim is opened through the platform's insurance.
_texte.La returnare, fotografiezi din nou echip: On return, you photograph the equipment again. If everything is in order, the payment is processed. Any damage is recorded and settled automatically.
_texte.Listează utilajele, sculele și echipamen: List your machinery, tools and equipment in the My Darrin marketplace and earn revenue from your idle fleet.
_texte.Listezi echipamentele în marketplace: You list your equipment in the marketplace
_texte.Pe durata închirierii echipamentul este: During the hire period the equipment is the customer's responsibility. My Darrin provides transport where needed.
_texte.Pot seta o perioadă minimă de închiriere: Can I set a minimum rental period?
_texte.Suma este pre-autorizată înainte de livr: The amount is pre-authorised before delivery — there's no risk of non-payment.
_texte.Transforma echipamentele inactive în ven: Turn idle equipment into steady income — My Darrin takes care of bookings, logistics and insurance.
_texte.Transportul poate fi asigurat de Curieru: Transport can be provided by the Neighbourhood Courier (for small/medium equipment) or by a specialist transport partner (for heavy machinery). The transport cost is paid by the customer.
_texte.Utilajele tale muncesc chiar și când tu: Your machinery works even when you have no projects of your own.
_texte.Vezi disponibilitatea în timp real și bl: See availability in real time and block the periods you want.
_texte.Înainte de predare fotografiezi echipame: Before handover you photograph the complete equipment. The customer digitally signs the handover report with the equipment's condition.
